Dr. Venom Dr. Venom was a scientist working for Cobra. He was the inventor of the Brainwave Scanner. QR QR is a character who appears in the G.I. Joe Roleplaying Game by Renegade Game Studios. She is used as a part of the introductory adventure, Snake Pit. Back-Stop Back-Stop is the roughest, hardest fighting man in the Joe Team. He has gone done and suffered it all. From broken bones, twisted noses, ripped tendons, it's almost like he has suffered every imaginable injury. But…

Who is Order?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" ! colspan="2" style="border:1px solid black" |Generation 1

Law & Order were first released as part of the 1987 series of ARAH toys. They were also available in 1988 and was discontinued in 1989. ----

Appearance: brown and black German shepherd hair (for Law's appearance, see Law (RAH))

Accessories: black spiked leash (For Law's accessories not directly related to Order, see Law (RAH)). ----
